Steam Drunk Coffee Maker + Steam Drunk Punk = Steam Drunk Coffee Maker Punk

5 - D-steam Rover:

Dust + Mars = Rover

D + Steam Rover = D-Steam Rover
D-Steam Rover + D-Steam Rover = D-steam Rover

5 - Dyson Rover:
